svg.title: XOR with a 2-2-1 step network
svg.desc: Left: inputs x1 and x2 feed hidden units h1 and h2 with weights 1, -1 and -1, 1, both with bias -0.5; the output adds h1 and h2 with weights 1, 1 and bias -0.5. Middle: truth table. Right: the unit square split by the lines x1 - x2 = 0.5 and x2 - x1 = 0.5; the two corner regions outside the band give output 1, the band between the lines gives output 0.
